# kotizi

> kotizi is a digital buying group for your own home, with no down payment, built on Stellar. It
> follows the Brazilian "consórcio" (a rotating savings and credit association): members join a
> group, pay a fixed installment before every draw, and each draw contemplates one eligible share at
> random, whose credit value is reserved for the property.

This is a hackathon demo (Stellar Meridian) running on Stellar testnet with test tokens: no real
money moves.

## How it works

- Groups: a fixed number of shares (2 to 64), the same installment for every share and one draw per
  period. Credit value = installment × shares; the admin fee is at most 10%.
- Sign in: email login through Privy, which creates an embedded Stellar wallet. Identity
  verification once (a demo form), required before joining a group.
- Shares: joining takes the group's next share and mints it as an NFT in the Kotizi contract, so the
  share and the right to pay with it move with the NFT.
- Installments: each share pays its installment into the group's pool once per period. Network fees
  and account reserves are paid by kotizi's backend (sponsored Soroban authorization entries), so
  users never hold XLM.
- Draw: after the due date anyone can start it ("Draw now"), and a backend keeper also does. The
  contract commits to a future drand quicknet round and verifies that round's BLS12-381 signature on
  chain, so nobody, kotizi included, can know or steer the result. Only shares that paid the current
  installment and haven't been contemplated yet are eligible.
- Credit: a contemplated share's credit stays in the contract, reserved for the company responsible
  for the property. Contemplated shares keep paying their installments until the group ends.

## Pages

- [kotizi](https://kotizifinance-meridian.vercel.app/): landing page and sign-in. Groups, payments
  and draws require a signed-in account.

## On chain

- [Kotizi contract on Stellar testnet](https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/contract/CDLG5PWRFTSLQNCWGFEBU4AEHKPMQCI5O4KXB3RGINP4Q2AY5BTQVFCR):
  the Soroban contract that holds the groups, the shares (NFTs), the payments and the draws.
- [drand](https://drand.love/): the public randomness beacon the draws use.
